name: Electricity - COAL - US average

processDocumentation.completenessDescription: This process contains no elementary flows. Provider weights sum to 1.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Balancing-authority resource shares are taken from the US Electricity Baseline process 'Electricity; at grid; consumption mix - US - US'.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: BA contributions are normalized within each resource to form a US-average provider mix.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This process represents a US-average mix of balancing-authority resource processes for one fuel.
processDocumentation.intendedApplication: US-average fuel-resource mixer for use with the U.S. Electricity Baseline.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Not applicable; this process contains only technosphere flows.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Provider weights are contribution = US_BA_weight × BA_resource_fraction, normalized within the resource so BA providers sum to 1.

processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Technosphere mixer only: weighted providers of balancing-authority resource processes. No elementary flows.
processDocumentation.timeDescription: This process represents the grid mix of the year modeled in the U.S. Electricity Baseline.
processDocumentation.useAdvice: Use as an estimated US-average fuel-resource provider where regional data are unknown. Emissions and other elementary flows come from the linked balancing-authority resource processes, not from this mixer.
